data.answer: According to the sources, alternatives to Geek Chic include Board Game Tables, Carolina Game Tables, Game On Tables, Rathskellers, and Wyrmwood, which is also entering the gaming table market. The sources mention that while Geek Chic set the standard for gaming tables, many competitors have emerged, and there are various quality alternatives available. The prices and specific details of these alternatives are not provided in the sources.

results.title: Geek Chic Gone? Build Your Own Gaming Table! – GeekDad
results.content: Nothing compared to the Sultan as the centerpiece of a gaming room. While amazing heirloom-quality pieces of furniture, each gaming table cost thousands, with a Sultan averaging twenty to thirty thousand dollars! There are many quality alternatives such as Board Game Tables, Carolina Game Tables, Game On Tables, Rathskellers, to name a few from just a very cursory web search, and Wyrmwood, the maker of high end gaming accessories, is also jumping into the gaming table market. [...] If you’re reading this, you’re likely the type of person to have already heard that Geek Chic has announced the sad news that they are ceasing operations. Geek Chic set the standard for treasured geek gaming tables. While many competitors have cropped up, Geek Chic was still the pinnacle of the gaming table market.
